trades.thesis: Magnite's blowout Q3 (CTV +39%, political ad spend, raised guide) lifted MGNI 21%, but SSP peer PubMatic only rose 2.6% ahead of its own Q3 print on 11-09 after close. Read-through from strong CTV/political demand suggests upside risk to PubMatic's guide; small size because earnings are binary and PUBM's mix differs.

causal_chain.step: Magnite Q3 beat: CTV +39%, political ad spend $12M and bigger in Q4, FY guide raised; MGNI +21%
PubMatic is a peer sell-side platform with CTV and political exposure, reports Q3 on 11-09 after close, and has lagged the read-through (+2.6%)
